summary: Defines an SMTP extension that lets a client send several commands at once instead of waiting for a reply to each. A server announces that it supports this, which cuts down on network round trips when delivering mail. It replaced RFC 1854 and was itself replaced by RFC 2920.

eli5.summary: Instead of asking one question and waiting for each answer, you hand over a whole list of questions and get the answers back together. Mail gets delivered faster.

questions: how to speed up smtp mail delivery
